response.sql: SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS AvgBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name

assumptions.assumption: 'Large files' means Track.Bytes >= 10323804 (threshold inclusive); tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded by the filter.
Grouping is per media type (MediaTypeId and Name), so media types with no large tracks do not appear. The ratio is computed per track using real division (not integer division), then averaged.

alternatives.interpretation: The threshold is strict: only files larger than 10323804 bytes count as large.
